charge_port.notes: Hyundai USA: legacy Hyundai EVs have native CCS ports (the 2025 IONIQ 5 is the first with a native NACS port).

supercharger_access.notes: Hyundai (US) provides a complimentary CCS-to-NACS adapter to eligible IONIQ 5 owners for Tesla Supercharger access (relayed by Motor.com, 2025-03); the Hyundai USA FAQ says native-CCS owners have access to NACS adapters.

wheels.notes: Limited RWD; SE/SEL RWD not opened.
